hypothesis: A weather-only, versioned LLM transition card adds proper-score information to the current Core Carry probability beyond same-row market and deterministic transition features, without acting as a gate or directly producing probability.
denominator: All first-valid Core Carry pre-live checkpoints in the frozen market-mid domain 0.80..0.9895; packet and card coverage are reported separately and all models are compared only on identical card-covered rows.
target: Current exact bracket holds at official settlement (label=1).
card_contract: intraday_state_transition_card_v1; weather-only input; LLM outputs categorical process/scenario/conflict/invalidation fields and never probability, EV, eligibility, sizing, or order action.
forward_protocol: Begin append-only prospective collection on 2026-08-07. Freeze packet input hash, prompt version, card schema, and LLM model identity before settlement. Do not score retrospective cards as forward evidence.
uncertainty: Target-date block bootstrap after at least 10 new settled target dates.
decision_rule: Promotion requires both Brier and logloss improvement versus frozen Core on frozen forward, with target-date 95% intervals excluding zero, and same-row market comparison reported. Otherwise retain as explanation/collector only.
